headline: Financial report of $12958.23, Veterans Day events, Wreaths Across America fundraisers, and Beverly Memeroy tree ornaments.
summary: The agenda lists a financial report of $12958.23 and Veterans Day events at 9:00 AM Beverly Farms, 10:00 Beverly Hospital, and 11:00 Vietnam Veterans Square. It also covers fundraisers for Wreaths Across America and updates from VFW 545, Legion 331, and BVV.
